problems.reason: The three sentences give mutually incompatible time ranges for Sinosaurus’s existence.
Both sentences state the same claim that jaw power estimates suggest Sinosaurus could have been either a carnivore or a scavenger.

notes: - contradiction: "Sinosaurus lived during the Sinemurian stage of the Jurassic period, approximately 196 to 183 million years ago." / "Sinosaurus lived at the beginning of the Jurassic period, from the Sinemurian to Pliensbachian stages, approximately 196 to 189 million years ago." / "Sinosaurus lived from the Hettangian to the Sinemurian stages, between 201.4 and 192.9 million years ago.": The three sentences give mutually incompatible time ranges for Sinosaurus’s existence.
